newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, spread widens.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, spread widens.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mixed, as commercial buying helped boost nearby March and widen the March/May spread, traders said.
Traders said some of the commercial buying may have been connected to Pakistan's upcoming tender for 312,000 tonnes of U.S. or Australian wheat.
MGE spring wheat ended 2-1/4 cents per bushel lower to four cents higher, with March up four cents at $3.94-1/4. May only gained 3/4 cent to close at $3.75-3/4.
The March/May spread widened to close at 18-1/2 cents on paper, compared to Tuesday's closing level of 15-1/4 cents.
Spring wheat was also buoyed periodically by strength in KCBT and CBOT wheat futures, which were higher on export hopes and weather concerns.
CIS was a featured buyer in Minneapolis, picking up 1.5 million March bushels. Wilson each bought at least 500,000 March. Country Hedging sold 1.1 million March and LFG sold 1.2 million March.
MGE barley futures settled four cents per bushel lower to three cents higher, with March down four cents at $6.65.
